scope: Well-defined tasks within one part of the codebase
technical: Writes working, tested code for clearly scoped tasks; learns the team's tools and conventions
delivery: Delivers tasks with guidance; asks for help when blocked for more than half a day
collaboration: Communicates progress and blockers clearly; takes feedback well
leadership: Learns from reviews; helps keep the team's docs current
typical_evidence: Merged pull requests with tests; bugs fixed; onboarding notes improved

technical: Designs and builds features end to end; writes tests at the right level; debugs production issues with help
delivery: Breaks features into small, safe changes; delivers predictably with light guidance
collaboration: Gives useful code reviews; works well with product and design
leadership: Mentors new joiners on tools and codebase; takes part in on-call
typical_evidence: Features shipped and measured; thoughtful reviews; on-call shifts handled

scope: Large features and parts of a system; guides the team
technical: Designs components with clear trade-offs; improves reliability, performance and security of what the team owns
delivery: Leads delivery of multi-week work; spots risks early and adjusts scope
collaboration: Leads design discussions; writes clear proposals; resolves disagreements constructively
leadership: Mentors engineers; raises the team's quality bar; leads incident response for the team's services
typical_evidence: Design documents; projects led to outcome; incidents led and postmortems; engineers mentored

scope: A team's technical direction, or a problem that spans teams
technical: Sets technical direction for an area; makes decisions that hold up for years; identifies and pays down risky debt
delivery: Delivers cross-team outcomes; unblocks other teams; shapes the roadmap with product
collaboration: Builds agreement across teams; writes for leaders outside engineering
leadership: IC: sponsors and grows senior engineers. Manager: hires, grows and retains a team; runs fair performance and growth conversations
typical_evidence: Decision records adopted by several teams; cross-team project delivered; team health and delivery metrics improved

scope: Several teams or a product area
technical: Defines architecture and standards for a product area; anticipates scaling, security and cost limits
delivery: Aligns several teams on shared outcomes; manages dependencies and trade-offs at area level
collaboration: Influences peers and leaders across functions; represents engineering in planning
leadership: IC: develops staff engineers; leads technical strategy for the area. Manager: grows managers; shapes organisation design
typical_evidence: Area strategy written and followed; multi-team outcomes; leaders developed

scope: An organisation or a technical domain across it
technical: Sets organisation-wide technical strategy and standards in a domain; judges build, buy or adopt decisions
delivery: Steers the portfolio of technical investment; stops work that no longer pays
collaboration: Trusted adviser to executives; explains technical risk in business terms
leadership: IC: shapes the engineering culture and career framework. Manager: owns budget, hiring plan and organisation health
typical_evidence: Strategy adopted across the organisation; major risks retired; organisation-level metrics improved

scope: The whole company and its standing outside
technical: Sets long-term technical direction for the company; recognised authority in the field
delivery: Accountable for company-level engineering outcomes and risk
collaboration: Represents the company externally to customers, regulators and the industry
leadership: Builds the leadership bench; sets the standards others are measured against
typical_evidence: Company-wide outcomes; external standards or open source contributions; leaders grown
